hook: One sheet of paper, eight pages, zero staples.
hookText: An 8-page zine from one A4 sheet

beats.say: Fold an A4 sheet in half three times, cut the center crease, fold it into a cross, and you get an eight-page booklet with no glue.
fanzines dot app lets you lay out each page right-side up, then places all eight panels on the sheet, top row rotated, as a 300 DPI PDF.
Everything stays in your browser. And a safe margin scales the layout to about 95 percent, so home printers don't clip the covers.
